title: Telemetry Sandpit Rehearsal for Interleaved Canaries and A/B Shadow Validations
content:
description:
Context and motivation: We see recurring incidents where interleaved canaries or multi-arm A/B promotions surface regressions only after prolonged traffic exposure. This PR introduces a 'telemetry sandpit' rehearsal lane: deterministic replay + stochastic smoke traffic that runs against candidate revisions in a low-risk production-adjacent environment. The goal is to surface latent regressions (latency tails, cache inefficiencies, memory pressure, token-level quality regressions) before a full traffic promote.

What this PR does: 1) Adds an OrbitRehearsal controller that schedules sandpit runs tied to rollout manifests. The controller can run dry-replays (deterministic) or blended synthetic smoke (stochastic) and attach telemetry anchors to each run. 2) Implements a ReplayProxy that can replay sampled real requests (prefix-preserving) with KV-cache-aware state seeding so replayed requests exercise the same runtime paths. 3) Introduces a RollbackPlanner service: after each rehearsal the planner scores risk via multi-metric heuristics (latency tail, error rate, token quality delta) and produces a suggested rollback plan (crediting pool, quarantine window, recommended freeze). 4) Adds telemetry hooks and lightweight audit records for sandpit runs (retention + access controls) so SRE and platform owners can correlate rehearsals with subsequent rollout behavior. 5) Small UX in console: a sandpit run timeline and one-click adopt/reject suggestion for rollouts.

Safety model and privacy: sandpit runs are opt-in per release and respect customer data redaction rules. ReplayProxy supports on-the-fly PII scrubbing and can be configured to only replay sanitized traffic. Sandpit runs default to an isolated capacity pool to avoid resource interference with customer serving lanes.

Operational controls and SLOs: runs are budgeted against a rollback-credit pool; the RollbackPlanner uses a decaying credit model to rate-limit auto-rollbacks. We added a cost-slo gate: rehearsals that exceed a token-cost budget are flagged and stop early.

Developer checklist: - [x] Controller scheduling and API surface - [x] Deterministic replay implementation with KV cache seeding - [x] Synthetic smoke generator (configurable distributions) - [x] RollbackPlanner heuristics + scoring - [x] Telemetry anchors and retention hooks - [x] Console timeline + adopt/reject action - [x] Unit + integration tests

Notes on scope: This PR focuses on the orchestration and safety plumbing. It intentionally leaves the advanced ML-level quality delta models (large-scale semantic drift detectors) as a follow-up (ENG-3020). The rollback suggestions are advisory by default; admins can toggle auto-apply policies per team.

Rollout example (how to opt-in): Add `rehearsal: {mode: "deterministic", sample_rate: 0.01, budget_tokens: 1e6}` to a rollout manifest. The controller will create a sandpit run, schedule replay batches, and attach telemetry anchors.

review_comments:
Arjun Patel: This looks promising. Two asks: 1) can we ensure the sandpit pool cannot starve dedicated capacity? 2) need explicit KMS/HSM handling for telemetry payloads.
Maya Chen (author): Addressed. Sandpit pool created as a lower-priority node pool and the controller refuses to schedule if FreedCapacity < threshold. KMS hooks added to telemetry recorder; see pkg/security/pii_scrubber.go and telemetry/sandpit_hooks.yaml.
Lena Fischer: RollbackPlanner scoring reads a bit opaque — can you add a doc with the exact scoring weights? Also request adding a conservative default that requires two independent metric gates to trigger auto-suggest.
Maya Chen (author): Added docs/rollouts/sandpit_rehearsal.md with scoring breakdown and set default gate to require 2 metric triggers for auto-suggest. See commit c7e4f22.
Carlos Mendez: CI e2e flaked once on the replay harness (timing). Recommend we add a retry/backoff on the proxy during replays.
Maya Chen (author): Implemented backoff with jitter in ReplayProxy and added integration test coverage.

release_notes:
Introduces 'telemetry sandpit' rehearsals to run deterministic replay and synthetic smoke against candidate model revisions. Adds a RollbackPlanner that generates advisory rollback plans after rehearsal runs. Opt-in via rollout manifest; protective defaults and PII scrubbing are enabled. See docs/rollouts/sandpit_rehearsal.md for configuration and operational guidance.

changelog_summary:
Add sandpit rehearsal lane: deterministic replay + smoke traffic, rollback planner, telemetry anchors, and console integration.

notes_for_oncall:
Oncall: sandpit runs create short-lived load in isolated pools. If the sandpit pool reports OOM or eviction pressure, the controller will cancel runs. Telemetry anchors are labeled 'sandpit' for easy filtering. If RollbackPlanner starts suggesting repetitive rollbacks for unrelated rollouts, escalate to infra and disable auto-suggest until triage.
